note: Round 1 produced five systematic changes to the author rather than twelve per-project patches, because twelve critics working blind of each other named the same defects. Each finding is answered individually and names the parameters that actually moved.

responses.expectedVisualEffect: Stress becomes the sparsest state and recovery the fullest, with neutral between them. RECOVERY reads 20/0/820 per mille across the ring where DRAWDOWN read 20/900/80, so the response now points the way the brief describes instead of the reverse.

responses.reason: The polarity is corrected and the drive is moved to the scale axis, but this runtime resolves scale as a ceiling the seed draws beneath rather than as a single settable size, so 'one object breathing' is approached rather than exactly delivered.

responses.expectedVisualEffect: Secondary members stay inside the primary's reach and are filled rather than hollow, so they read as subordinate structure instead of as detached debris or crate slats.
